parallel.requirements: Recognized the URL encode/decode behavior, fixed URL components, exact stdout, no-args exit, no external crates, Cargo/Rust 2021 structure, root test17.rs, and black-box probing requirement.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Despite swarm mode being injected, the main actor retained all ownership. It did not launch AgentSwarm or direct subagents and instead performed exploration, implementation, correction, verification, and final response itself.
parallel.implementation: Wrote Cargo.toml, url_parser/mod.rs, url_parser/encoding.rs, url_parser/url.rs, and test17.rs. It implemented byte-oriented encoding/decoding, raw argv handling on Unix, URL component accessors, and decoded query parameter values after differential testing exposed the first mismatch.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Integrated the root test17.rs with the local url_parser module tree, built the Cargo binary, then compiled a standalone /output/test17 executable with rustc and left the expected artifact set in /output.
parallel.verification: Ran reference probes for examples and edge cases, found a query_params mismatch, reran a diff script to ALL PASS, then ran an 800-case fuzz plus long-input comparison and a standalone rustc build check.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unresolved task work is visible at closure; the current official evaluator completed and passed all 40 testcases.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same CLI, URL encode/decode, parser output, byte-for-byte stdout, zero-dependency, Cargo/Rust 2021, root test17.rs, and black-box inference requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single main actor tracked three local todos for probing, implementation, and build/compare. No child agents or delegation appeared in the serial protocol or raw timeline.
serial.implementation: Wrote Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/url_parser.rs, and test17.rs. It first used String-based decoding, then changed query_params to decode internally and finally added byte-slice decoding so invalid UTF-8 bytes were preserved.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Integrated a library target and root binary, built target/release/test17, compiled /output/test17_rustc with rustc, and left the required root entry file and Cargo project artifacts.
serial.verification: Probed the C++ executable, compared outputs for a battery of edge cases, fixed mismatches for query parameter double-decoding and invalid UTF-8, then got pass=31 fail=0 before finalizing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unresolved task work is visible at closure; the current official evaluator completed and passed all 40 testcases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel saw the full prompt: Rust 2021, std-only, exact CLI/stdout behavior, /output project layout, black-box inference from the executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial saw the same prompt and requirement set, including exact byte-for-byte output and the ban on reading C++ library source.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference. Both focused on URL encoding, decoding, URL components, query params, output bytes, and build artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had swarm mode available but no child delegation. The main actor kept ownership of probing, coding, fixes, verification, and delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a TodoList with local phases and no delegation, keeping all work under the main actor.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel run did not create a multi-agent decomposition; the serial run used explicit local progress tracking. Both had a single effective implementation owner.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had no child brief, handoff, cross-agent contract, or child return; all interface decisions stayed in the main actor's context.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise had no cross-agent context boundary; the main actor kept discoveries and code edits in one trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no concurrency-specific context-transfer difference. The only contrast is that the parallel run carried a swarm-mode reminder that was not acted on.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a module directory with encoding.rs and url.rs plus test17.rs, then changed query_params to decoded byte pairs after a differential mismatch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a src/url_parser.rs library and root test17.rs, then iterated from String-based decode to byte-vector and byte-slice decode after mismatches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both converged on equivalent behavior. Parallel reached raw-byte handling earlier; serial took extra corrective edits for invalid UTF-8, but both solved the task.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: No delegated result lifecycle existed. The main actor inspected its own diff results, applied fixes, reran tests, and completed normally.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: No child result lifecycle existed in serial. The main actor inspected mismatches, patched code, reran tests, updated todos, and completed normally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither mode had child results to join, ignore, cancel, or return. Their lifecycle difference is only local: parallel ran a later fuzz pass; serial recorded todo completion.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created Cargo.toml, root test17.rs, and url_parser module files in one main-agent sequence, with artifact validation listing those files and the compiled executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/url_parser.rs, root test17.rs, target/release/test17, and an extra rustc-built executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The final tree structures differ, but neither had concurrent writes, shared-workspace collisions, overwrites by another actor, or contamination.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran example/edge probes, a differential test that first failed, an ALL PASS rerun, an 800-case fuzz plus long input, rustc build, and then official evaluation passed 40/40.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran example/edge probes, a 31-input comparison that exposed two rounds of mismatches, fixed them, got pass=31 fail=0, and then official evaluation passed 40/40.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both verified against the reference and passed official tests. Parallel added broader randomized fuzzing; serial used a smaller but sufficient targeted byte comparison.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed in about 499 agent seconds, did not time out, used no subagents, and closed after presenting its verified artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in about 498 agent seconds, did not time out, used no subagents, and closed after todo completion and a final verified-artifact summary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No budget-driven divergence. Both used nearly the same wall budget and closed after verification; no child fan-out, waiting, or cancellation consumed parallel capacity.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome: both current cell/status.json evaluation records completed and passed 40/40. The parallel attempt did not execute a child-agent mechanism, so there is no parallel coordination episode to connect to the outcome. The attempts differed mainly in local implementation layout and verification breadth while both delivered correct artifacts.
parallel_contributors: The main actor performed all work directly: reference probing, file writes, query_params correction, differential testing, fuzzing, rustc build, and final response.
serial_contributors: The serial actor also performed all work directly, using a local todo list and iterative fixes until a 31-input byte comparison passed.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel split the library into url_parser/mod.rs, encoding.rs, and url.rs, while serial used src/lib.rs and src/url_parser.rs.
Both initially missed some query parameter or byte-output detail and corrected it after local differential tests; those were ordinary implementation iterations, not multi-agent coordination failures.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; supported by both completed official evaluations and absence of executed parallel delegation
